original_ai_output.title_zh: 奥约州向市场火灾受灾商户移交88间重建商铺
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 奥约州政府向伊巴丹Alesinloye市场火灾受灾商户免费移交88间重建商铺。伊巴丹西南地方政府执行主席Kehinde Akande代表州长Seyi Makinde于周三完成移交，称此举兑现了州长灾后视察时的承诺。火灾发生在市场塑料与橡胶区，烧毁多家商铺及价值数百万奈拉的货物。

location.raw_text: Alesinloye Market in Ibadan, Oyo State

key_facts.fact: 奥约州政府向伊巴丹Alesinloye市场火灾受灾商户移交88间重建商铺
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Oyo State Government has handed over 88 newly reconstructed shops to traders affected by a fire outbreak at Alesinloye Market in Ibadan.

key_facts.fact: 移交由伊巴丹西南地方政府执行主席Kehinde Akande代表州长Seyi Makinde于周三完成
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Executive Chairman of Ibadan South-West Local Government, Kehinde Akande, performed the handover on Wednesday on behalf of Governor Seyi Makinde.

key_facts.fact: 火灾发生在市场塑料与橡胶区，烧毁多家商铺及价值数百万奈拉的货物
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The inferno, which occurred in the plastic and rubber section of the market, destroyed several shops and goods worth millions of naira.

uncertainties: 火灾具体发生时间及原因未在报道中说明
目前仅单一来源（Punch）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
